Insecure under R-4.5. Safe 0x160c61636d3718b86979f8fba4f691f1f492acd5 (Safe 1.4.1) on Ethereum Mainnet, Safe transaction 0xc85a4472a1fbff72ebe984ce43104a0f461b49bc673afb36d3b975df14682860 (nonce 91), Charter bafkreigg6ajqdb52kb644wcxegurt7r6jlclru4mjy3lwxkbh6avm3vgre. The transaction delegate calls MultiSendCallOnly 1.4.1, whose first call is approve(0x02912516d49de997db75b9d7858faae59209650b, 2^256-1) on the ERC-20 token 0xe0181090c22579b6a217f1522cbf8c9f1f0c1965 (VaultV2, whose ERC-20 Approval and Transfer events precede the proposal). Under § 2.5 and R-4.5, a max uint256 ERC-20 approval is always functionally unlimited and fails immediately, whatever the interaction needs and whatever approvals the Safe granted before. Precedents applied: 0x9f7ccd78…, 0x46a105a5… (max approvals, insecure); approvals of non-max amounts and an R-4.4 ruling distinguished.
